dead_ends.why_it_failed: the alias makes summittrailgear.example links count as internal (in-scope), so external links = 0 and --check-external has nothing to check. Re-ran without --alias per the dispatch note ('with the alias NOT set they're external') and got the intended 4 external targets.

divergence_carry_decision: Extended the toRender Map<string,string[]> to Map<string,EscalationCandidate> where EscalationCandidate = {signals, staticHtml: string|null, staticExtraction: ExtractionResult|null}. Populated from the Cheerio requestHandler's own already-computed html/extraction locals for (a) real JS-detection escalations and (b) 403/429 fetch-retry escalations (both have a genuine static body). Left null for pure network-failure retries (timeout/DNS never received a response, so there is nothing to diff). Chose 'carry in the map' over 're-read the saved static file' to avoid an extra disk read and because the static extraction was already sitting in scope.
